papers.title_in_file: Quantum Parameter Study for Quantum Inspired Machine Learning
papers.what_it_is: A three-page author-published note (K. Kawchak, ChemicalQDevice, 2023-09-26) on how the number of trainable Ry parameters in a 4-qubit circuit assisting a ResNet50 changes validation accuracy on three image datasets.

assertions.value: The authors label the ResNet50 neural network as holding 23M non-trainable parameters.
quotes: Figure 1a: ResNet50 Neural Network 23M Non-Trainable Parameters 1
assertions.certainty_reason: The paper states its own setup in the Figure 1a caption.

assertions.value: The authors state that a ResNet50 neural network without trainable parameters is assisted in classifying images by a 4-qubit quantum circuit with trainable parameters, and that Accuracy, Loss and Runtime metrics are analyzed for three different sized datasets.
quotes: Synopsis: A ResNet50 Neural Network without trainable parameters is assisted classifying images with a 4-qubit Quantum Circuit with trainable parameters for the analysis of Accuracy, Loss, and Runtime metrics for three different sized datasets.
assertions.certainty_reason: The Synopsis states the paper's own setup.
assertions.reader_inference: The text pages of the paper report no Runtime result; the Runtime metric named in the synopsis is not reported in the text layer (it may sit in Figure 1d or the other figures).

assertions.value: The authors describe the quantum circuit in Figure 1b as an embedding layer on the left, up to 40 trainable parameters in the middle, and measurements on the right.
quotes: Figure 1b: Quantum Circuit. Left: Embedding Layer 2 Middle: Up to 40 Trainable Parameters, Right: Measurements
assertions.certainty_reason: The Figure 1b caption states the circuit design.

assertions.value: The authors list three datasets: 2-Class Hymenoptera, 10-Class Tumor MRI and 44-Class Tumor MRI.
quotes: Figure 1c: Datasets. 1) 2-Class Hymenoptera 2) 10-Class Tumor MRI, 3) 44-Class Tumor MRI
assertions.certainty_reason: The Figure 1c caption states the datasets used.

assertions.value: The authors name Default.qubit (a simulator device, cited to the PennyLane documentation) and an NVIDIA V100 16 GB as the device and hardware of the study.
assertions.certainty_reason: The footer line states the paper's own device setup.
assertions.reader_inference: Default.qubit is PennyLane's classical state-vector simulator, so the circuit was simulated on a GPU machine and not run on quantum hardware. The paper does not say this in words.

assertions.value: The authors state that different numbers of trainable Ry layers were implemented in a Quantum transfer learning model, to study the effect of increasing circuit parameters on a single dataset and any observable trends between datasets.
quotes: In this study, different numbers of trainable Ry layers were implemented in a
model in order to study the effect increasing circuit parameters has on a single dataset, as well as any observable trends between datasets.
assertions.certainty_reason: The Introduction states the purpose and scope of the study.

assertions.value: The authors report that the 2-Class Hymenoptera dataset, used as a standard, did not experience improvements in accuracy with more trainable quantum parameters.
quotes: 1) 2-Class Hymenoptera as a Standard did not experience improvements in accuracy with more trainable quantum parameters
assertions.reader_inference: The text gives no accuracy values, number of runs or variance, so the size of the effect cannot be judged from the text.

assertions.value: The authors report that the 10-Class Tumor MRI dataset experienced the largest increase in accuracies as the number of parameters was increased.
quotes: 2) 10-Class Tumor MRI dataset experienced the largest increase in accuracies as the number of parameters were increased
assertions.reader_inference: No accuracy values are in the text; the claim rests on Figure 1d, which the text layer does not carry.

assertions.value: The authors report that the 44-Class Tumor MRI dataset had small improvements in accuracy for a lower number of trainable parameters.
quotes: 3) 44-Class Tumor MRI dataset had small improvements in accuracy for lower number of trainable parameters

assertions.value: The authors report that the 10-Class and 44-Class datasets both generally increased in accuracy for the first 20 trainable parameters, while the Hymenoptera dataset did not appear to exhibit a positive response to additional trainable parameters.
quotes: Although the Hymenoptera dataset did not appear to exhibit a positive response to additional trainable parameters, the 10-Class and 44-Class datasets both generally increased in accuracy for the first 20 trainable parameters.

assertions.value: The authors state that, with fewer total tumor classes and more images per class, the 10-Class dataset yielded the best accuracy increases for the highest number of parameters.
quotes: With less total number of tumor classes and a greater number of images per class, the 10-Class dataset yielded the best accuracy increases for the highest number of parameters.
assertions.reader_inference: The paper gives no experiment that separates class count from images per class, so this explanation is untested in the text.

assertions.value: The authors report that differences between training and validation losses were the lowest for the 10-class set at 40 parameters, and state this may indicate less concern of overfitting.
quotes: Differences between training and validation losses were the lowest for the 10-class set for 40 parameters, which may indicate less concerns of overfitting.
assertions.reader_inference: The authors hedge with 'may'. No loss values are in the text.

assertions.value: The authors state that quantum inspired methods and devices will likely be able to optimize large numbers of parameters, and that a productive approach will likely be to find the minimum number of parameters needed to assist classical deep learning.
quotes: As quantum inspired methods and devices will likely be able to optimize large numbers of parameters, a productive approach will likely be to find the minimum number of parameters needed to assist classical deep learning.

assertions.value: The authors state that the study provided insight into parameter selection when best quality datasets are used.
quotes: This study provided insight into parameter selection when best quality datasets are used.
assertions.certainty_reason: The Discussion states the scope of the study's findings.
assertions.reader_inference: Read as a scope limit: the findings are stated for best quality datasets only. The text does not define best quality.

assertions.value: The authors state that this study builds from prior algorithm prototypings, benchmarking, and cost/efficiency studies, and that the larger tumor datasets were also independently analyzed with larger circuits in separate studies.
quotes: This study builds from prior algorithm prototypings, benchmarking, and cost/efficiency studies.
The larger tumor datasets were also independently analyzed w/ larger circuits in separate studies.
assertions.reader_inference: The cited items are the author's own LinkedIn posts and company R&D updates (references 7 to 12), not peer-reviewed work.
